strings.note: Toast when the beer font is clicked while a finished cocktail is still waiting to be served. Toast line, one line, ~24 characters.
Toast when the beer font is clicked while a cocktail is still being built in the shaker. Toast line, one line, ~24 characters.

Fallback reaction a customer shouts over a serve that was exactly right, in the pop-up over the stool, when the bar has no voice lines loaded. Sentence case, display face 14 px in a 178 px strip, ~14 characters.
Fallback reaction over a serve that earns another round (no voice lines loaded). Sentence case, display face 14 px in a 178 px strip, ~14 characters.
Fallback reaction over a serve that was close enough (no voice lines loaded). Sentence case, display face 14 px in a 178 px strip, ~14 characters.
Fallback reaction over a serve of the wrong drink (no voice lines loaded). Sentence case, display face 14 px in a 178 px strip, ~18 characters.

strings.text: Perfect pour. Not a thing I would change.
strings.note: Fallback first-sip line in a customer's speech balloon for a flawless pour (no voice lines loaded). Sentence case; the balloon wraps, a few short lines.
Toast when a bowl of snacks is put down in front of a customer. {snack} = the snack's name in capitals. Toast line, one line, ~28 characters.
Hover tip over a snack bowl on the counter. {snack} = the snack's name in capitals. Prop tip plate, one line, ~20 characters.
Toast when an empty snack bowl on the counter is clicked. {snack} = the snack's name in capitals. Toast line, one line, ~32 characters.
Toast when a snack bowl is picked up: click a customer to give it to them. {snack} = the snack's name in capitals. Toast line, one line, ~34 characters.
Toast when the snack bowl in hand is clicked again and set back down. Toast line, ~14 characters.
Label under a snack bowl on the counter. {snack} = the snack's name in capitals; {left} = servings left (whole number). Body face 8 px in a 96 px label, ~14 characters.
Label under a snack bowl with nothing left. {snack} = the snack's name in capitals. Body face 8 px in a 96 px label, ~14 characters.

strings.text: KEEPS IT COLD · DROP IT IN BEFORE THE POUR
strings.note: Fallback 'what it is for' line on the garnish card over the ice bucket, used only when the preparation carries no description. Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.

strings.text: A TWIST OF PEEL · SHARPENS A SOUR DRINK
strings.note: Fallback 'what it is for' line on the garnish card over the lemon dish. Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.

strings.text: SALT ROUND THE RIM · TURN THE GLASS IN THE DISH
strings.note: Fallback 'what it is for' line on the garnish card over the salt dish. Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.

strings.text: SUGAR ROUND THE RIM · TURN THE GLASS IN THE DISH
strings.note: Fallback 'what it is for' line on the garnish card over the sugar dish. Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.
'What it is for' line on the garnish card over the olive jar (the olive has no preparation description, so this always shows). Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.
'What it is for' line on the garnish card over the mint dish (always shows). Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.

strings.text: A GARNISH THE ORDER MAY ASK FOR
strings.note: Fallback 'what it is for' line on the garnish card for a garnish with no line of its own. Capitals; wraps on the card, two short lines.
Short caption of the ice bucket on the counter's garnish rail; fills {word} in chrome.garnish.meta_ice on the garnish card. Capitals, ~12 characters.
Short caption of the lemon dish on the counter's garnish rail; fills {word} in chrome.garnish.meta_garnish. Capitals, ~12 characters.
Short verb caption of the salt dish on the garnish rail (the glass is turned in it for a salt rim); fills {word} in chrome.garnish.meta_rim. Capitals, ~20 characters.
Short verb caption of the sugar dish on the garnish rail (sugar rim); fills {word} in chrome.garnish.meta_rim. Capitals, ~20 characters.
Short caption of the olive jar on the counter's garnish rail; fills {word} in chrome.garnish.meta_garnish. Capitals, ~12 characters.
Short caption of the mint dish on the counter's garnish rail; fills {word} in chrome.garnish.meta_garnish. Capitals, ~12 characters.
Hover tip over an empty glass a customer left on the counter: drag it to the sink. Prop tip plate, one line, ~22 characters.
Hover tip over the bar towel hanging on the counter rail (used to wipe marks). Prop tip plate, one line, ~14 characters.
Hover tip over a dirty mark left on the counter: wipe it with the cloth. Prop tip plate, one line, ~18 characters.

strings.text: CLICK TO EDIT · DRAG TO SERVE
strings.note: Hover tip over the finished drink standing on the counter's coaster: a click goes back to the bench, a drag carries it to a customer. Prop tip plate, one line, ~30 characters.
Small hint label on top of the finished drink on the counter. Body face 10 px in a 190 px strip, one line, ~26 characters.

strings.text: PUT BACK — CARRY IT TO THE SINK
strings.note: Toast when a carried empty glass is let go somewhere other than the sink and goes back on the counter. Toast line, one line, ~32 characters.
Toast when the sink is used (washing glasses, pouring a drink away) while its tap is still running from the last use. Toast line, ~20 characters.
Toast when glasses go into the sink and the wash starts. Toast line, ~14 characters.
Toast when the sink is clicked with no dirty glasses in hand. Toast line, ~16 characters.

Seconds left on the sink's wash timer, on a small badge at the dial's corner. {secs} = whole seconds (1-9 usually). Display face 16 px on a 30x20 badge: ~3 characters at most — keep the unit to one letter.

strings.text: LAST CALL · CLEAR THE COUNTER TO CLOSE
strings.note: Line over the sink when every customer has left but glasses or marks remain on the counter: the night will not close until it is clean. Body face 8 px, one line over a 240 px strip (may overhang), ~40 characters.
Line over the sink while its tap runs. May be followed by seats.strip.held. Body face 8 px, one line, ~12 characters.
Line over the sink while the player holds dirty glasses. {n} = glasses in hand. May be followed by seats.strip.held. Body face 8 px, one line, ~28 characters.
As seats.strip.in_hand#one.

Line over the sink: {line} (seats.strip.washing or seats.strip.in_hand) followed by how many stools are blocked until those glasses are washed. {n} = stools held. Body face 8 px, one line, ~44 characters in all.
As seats.strip.held#one.
Toast when a garnish jar (olive, mint) is dropped into a drink but the bar's stock of it has run out. Toast line, ~12 characters.
Toast when a garnish from a jar is dropped into a glass that is already full. Toast line, ~18 characters.
Toast when an olive or mint garnish lands in the glass. {bottle} = the garnish product's name in capitals. Toast line, one line, ~30 characters.
Toast when the player tries to finish a pint with anything but a lemon or a rim of salt. Toast line, ~14 characters.
Toast when a garnish the drink already has is dropped on it again. Toast line, ~22 characters.
Toast when an ice cube is dropped into the glass. {cubes} = cubes now in it (whole number); 'x' is a multiplier sign, keep it next to the number. Toast line, ~22 characters.
Toast when a garnish (lemon twist...) is put on the drink. {garnish} = the garnish's name in capitals. Toast line, one line, ~26 characters.
Toast when the salt-rim circling mini-game is completed. Toast line, ~18 characters.
Toast when the sugar-rim circling mini-game is completed. Toast line, ~18 characters.
Progress of the rim circling mini-game, in the middle of the ring over the glass. {pct} = 0-100. Display face 8 px, ~5 characters; put the % sign where the language writes it.
Toast when a finished drink is dragged into the sink and poured away for free. Toast line, ~14 characters.
Toast when a finished drink is poured away and its ingredients are written off. {fee} = the cost with minus and currency sign, e.g. -$4. Toast line, ~22 characters.
Hover label over the shaker standing on the counter: click to go back to the shaker bench. Display face 8 px on a 160x22 plate, ~18 characters.
Toast when the shaker with a half-built drink is dragged into the sink and emptied for free. Toast line, ~14 characters.
Toast when the shaker is emptied into the sink and its contents written off. {fee} = the cost with minus and currency sign, e.g. -$4. Toast line, ~22 characters.
Toast when a drink is dragged onto a customer whose ID card has not been read yet. Toast line, ~20 characters.

strings.text: THEY LEFT — YOU GET THE DRINK BACK
strings.note: Toast when the customer a drink was sliding toward is gone by the time it arrives; the drink returns to the counter. Toast line, one line, ~36 characters.
Floating figure rising off a stool when a customer leaves a tip. {tip} = the amount with plus and currency sign, e.g. +$3. Display face 16 px, one line, ~10 characters.

Service log line (the LOG sheet) when a finished drink is poured away at a cost. Keep the <color> tags around the first words. {fee} = the cost with minus and currency sign, e.g. -$4. Body face 8 px, one line, ~40 characters.
Service log line when the shaker's half-built drink is emptied at a cost. Keep the <color> tags. {fee} = the cost with minus and currency sign, e.g. -$4. Body face 8 px, one line, ~40 characters.
Service log line when a customer is thrown out and the kick does not count against the night. Keep the <color> tags. {reason} = why (id.kick_reason.*). Body face 8 px, one line, ~40 characters.

Service log line when a customer is thrown out and scores the night. Keep the <color> tags. {reason} = why (id.kick_reason.*); {stars} = the score as asterisks (empty for zero). Body face 8 px, one line, ~44 characters.

Service log line when a customer walks out before being served. Keep the <color> tags. {drink} = the ordered drink's name in capitals, or ? if the card was never read; {paid} = the money taken with currency sign ($0); {stars} = the score as asterisks (empty). Body face 8 px, one line, ~50 characters.

Service log line when a customer pays their tab and leaves. Keep the <color> tags. {paid} = the total with currency sign, e.g. $14; {stars} = their score as one to five asterisks. Body face 8 px, one line, ~40 characters.
As seats.log.tab, for a customer who also had snacks. {n} = snack bowls served to them. Body face 8 px, one line, ~50 characters.
As seats.log.tab_snacks#one.
Order balloon over a customer's head while they drink; one to three animated dots are added after it. Sentence case, body face, ~12 characters (the balloon sizes to it, max ~200 px).
Order balloon over a customer who has decided but whose ID card has not been read yet. Sentence case, body face, ~16 characters.
Order balloon over the story's guest of the house: the ask is in the dialogue, not on the ticket. Sentence case, body face, ~16 characters.
Name of tonight's or tomorrow's crowd (the wealthy one) on the day-end slip's date line and the standing board's TOMORROW row. Capitals, ~14 characters.
Name of the poor crowd on the day-end slip's date line and the standing board's TOMORROW row. Capitals, ~14 characters.
Name of the ordinary crowd on the day-end slip's date line and the standing board's TOMORROW row. Not the relationship 'regular' on the ID card. Capitals, ~14 characters.
Hover tip over the beer font standing on the counter in the room: click to go to the draught station. Prop tip plate, one line, ~14 characters.
Hover tip over the sink on the counter: a drink dragged there is poured away, a click washes the glasses in hand. Prop tip plate, one line, ~24 characters.
